name: seeless-uia
description: Windows UI Automation CLI for AI agents -- native app interaction via UIA

scripts.build:native:
dotnet build SeelessUIA.slnx -c Release --force && copy src in\Release
et10.0-windows\SeelessUIA.exe bin\SeelessUIA.exe && copy src in\Release
et10.0-windows\SeelessUIA.dll bin\SeelessUIA.dll && copy src in\Release
et10.0-windows\SeelessUIA.runtimeconfig.json bin\SeelessUIA.runtimeconfig.json && copy src in\Release
et10.0-windows\SeelessUIA.deps.json bin\SeelessUIA.deps.json && xcopy /E /Y src in\Release
et10.0-windows\skill-data bin\skill-data\

author: yaki1210
